title: Identity system in changing contexts
slide_intent: Test an identity across different content so viewers can recognize the provider while the offer and emotional tone change.
strategic_value: A repeated mark, blue fields and rounded typography can connect O2 products, entertainment and everyday experiences.
demonstration: A modular collage cycles through light, blue and warmer event treatments across buttons, campaign photography, product cards, a bubble and headline specimens.
practical_value: Compare stable ingredients with variable imagery and color before extending the system to another campaign.

content_islands.name: Modular field
content_islands.spec: Arrange rounded panels in a compact mosaic with narrow pale gutters.

content_islands.name: Applications and ingredients
content_islands.spec: Mix a horizontal campaign, portrait photography, a product offer, interactive button, logo, bubble and wide headline panel.

content_islands.name: Changing treatments
content_islands.spec: Cycle the contents and color fields while retaining the panel arrangement.

reference_purposes.Intent: The case-study introduction frames the system as a digital-first renewal of oxygen through color, bubbles and typography.
reference_purposes.Expression: The mosaic shows recurring O2 blue, bubble shading and rounded lettering alongside several photographic moods.
reference_purposes.Application: The panels place those ingredients in button, advertising and product-offer contexts.
